items.title: Add Dailymotion Private API keys (Pro)
items.detail: No Playwright. Free accounts cannot create Private API keys. When you have Studio Pro keys: put DAILYMOTION_API_KEY/SECRET/PROFILE_ID in .env then python scripts/setup_dailymotion.py --push. Actions uploads with laptop off.

items.detail: ODYSEE_YOUTUBE_SYNC=true is set in GitHub secrets. One-time: claim @ClickCaseFiles and link YT at sync.odysee.tv. After that new YT uploads mirror with laptop off. No Playwright.

items.title: Spotify video needs partner host API (no DIY upload API)
items.detail: Spotify has no self-serve upload API. For Actions automation use Libsyn/Podigee/Audioboom Distribution API and set SPOTIFY_HOST_* secrets, or upload video episodes manually in Spotify for Creators. Playwright path removed.
